#  13491 - English B1.1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13491**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **English B1.1**  |  
|  Englisch B1.1   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Riebow, Ute 
  * D'Onofrio, Gabriella 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After finishing this course participants can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc. They can deal with most situations likely to arise whilst travelling in an area where the language is spoken and can produce simple connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest. They can describe experiences and events, dreams, hopes and ambitions and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans.  |  
| Contents:  | Action-oriented tasks for global, selective and detailed listening and reading comprehension, for the production of topic and situation-related written texts, for topic and situation-related oral expression as well as exercises for comprehension and consolidation of linguistic structures (vocabulary and grammar). In addition, learning strategies and techniques for self-study are presented and practised.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of English on pre-intermediate level is strongly recommended (CEFR A2).  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Speakout, 3rd edition, B1 (coursebook), additional material on Moodle  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 5 tests of 45-60 minutes each (accounting for 20% each of final grade)  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Environmental and Resource Management / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Online registration via Moodle 


  * This module aims at exchange students with an English language competence at level CEFR A2+/B1. It is not suited for students with a lower English language competence.


  * The course can be held as an online live session.

 |  
| Module Components:  | Exercise English B1.1 (4 hpw in winter or summer term)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
